ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What are the eligibility criteria for admission?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: We accept players between the ages of 6 and 18. Basic football skills, fitness level, and passion for the game are considered during selection. A trial session is required before admission.
Trials are usually conducted twice a year – once in January and again in July. Exact dates are announced on our website and social media pages.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What kind of training does the academy offer?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content:
Our training programs include:

  • Technical and tactical football training

  • Physical fitness and conditioning

  • Match reading and strategy

  • Specialized goalkeeping training (if applicable)

  • Mental strength and teamwork development

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: When are the training sessions held?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Training sessions are conducted 3 to 5 days a week, depending on the age group. We offer both morning and evening batches.

ekit_accordion_items.acc_title: What are the qualifications of the coaches?
ekit_accordion_items.acc_content: Our coaching staff includes AFC/UEFA licensed coaches with national and international experience. They are highly skilled in player development and modern coaching techniques.
